verdict.rationale: Cline can execute terminal commands live (running tests, dev servers) and react to output, apply multi-file edits with diffs/checkpoints and one-click undo, and spawn subagents to research the codebase independently — all of which support reproducing bugs, narrowing causes, and verifying fixes. However, there is no dedicated debugging workflow, root-cause-analysis tooling, or explicit test-verification loop documented; support is inferred from general agentic/terminal/diff features rather than a purpose-built bug-reproduction capability. Missing for 10: explicit reproduce/root-cause debugging feature docs, structured test-verification workflow, hands-on evidence of successful bug-fix verification.
